entities.name: C5DQ25
observations: Exact sequence match to the 135-residue query protein; reviewed UniProt reference from Zygosaccharomyces rouxii.
Annotated as Outer spore wall protein 5 and involved in spore wall assembly.
Annotated as a membrane, multi-pass membrane protein.
Two predicted/reference transmembrane helices span residues 2–22 and 25–45; residues 46–135 are cytoplasmic.
A disordered region is annotated at residues 70–122, with a polar compositionally biased segment at residues 70–87.

entities.name: Osw5 domain
observations: Pfam Osw5 (PF17062.12) detected in the query sequence at residues 6–74 with i-Evalue 3.3e-27.

entities.name: Spore wall assembly
observations: The exact matched protein is annotated as participating in spore wall assembly in Zygosaccharomyces rouxii.

entities.name: Query protein
observations: Length 135 amino acids; calculated molecular weight 14.52 kDa; theoretical pI 9.10; predicted net charge at pH 7 of +1.59.
Sequence contains two strong hydrophobic segments near the N-terminus, consistent with a compact bitopic hairpin membrane topology rather than a cleavable secretory signal peptide alone.
The C-terminal half is relatively polar and includes low-complexity/proline- and serine-rich sequence, consistent with a cytoplasmic disordered tail.
